purpose: Validation & engineering accuracy of the Phase 4 learning system — NOT new features. Real, measured numbers from this sandbox.

list.defect: Unsupported-assumption check only caught 'assume' wording; 'the rail is 5V' / 'let R=5' slipped through.
list.fix: Broadened to catch 'the X is <num>', 'let X = <num>', and 'X of <num>' assertions; added source-word allow-list; skip when the value is given in the prompt or equals the user's conclusion.

list.defect: Measurement-misinterpretation check required both '0 v' AND 'no voltage' literally; '0V means the rail is dead' slipped through.
list.fix: Broadened to catch 'dead', 'no power', 'absent', 'nothing', '0v means' without a stated ground reference.

list.defect: Logic check only flagged answers under 6 words; a 7+ word answer with no reasoning connective passed.
list.fix: Gate on the presence of a reasoning connective (so/therefore/because/...) OR step-words (substitut/first/then/...), regardless of length.

list.defect: Unit normalization broken for 'kΩ' (lowercases to 'mω' = milli) and unrecognized units (H, W) were silently accepted.
list.fix: Canonical (base_dimension, prefix) table; flag a unit whose base dimension differs from the reference, or that is unrecognized.

list.defect: Answer extractor picked the FIRST '= number' (often a given value mid-reasoning) and fell back to the last bare number (could be an index).
list.fix: Priority order: explicit 'answer/result/therefore is X' -> last '= X unit' -> trailing 'number unit' -> last bare number guarded against label-like numbers (exercise/step/page).

list.defect: No physical validation: a 1V @ 3A -> 0.33 Ω 'load' (near-short) or a 60V @ 0.001A 'load' (leakage) could be generated.
list.fix: physical_validation module; each generator draws params up to 8 times until V/I/P/R are in board-level bounds; invalid draws return None (exercise rejected).

list.defect: Divider generator could produce a degenerate case (Vout < 0.3V, or R1+R2 out of range).
list.fix: validate_divider checks Vout in [0.3, Vin], total in [1k, 10M], quiescent current in [1µA, 10mA].

list.defect: RC valid_range was in seconds only, but the prompt asks for seconds AND ms — a correct ms answer was marked wrong.
list.fix: Unit-aware valid_range with min_s/max_s AND min_ms/max_ms + accept_units; the evaluator picks the band matching the user's unit.

list.defect: upsert_exercise overwrote the reference_solution in place; a regenerated exercise would invalidate in-flight responses.
list.fix: D9 guard: if an exercise key already has responses, upsert refreshes only non-grading metadata; the reference/prompt/valid_range are frozen.

list.defect: Exercises were number-swaps of one template (always 'V and I -> R'); no transfer to a different circuit condition.
list.fix: generate_transfer() with 4 new shapes: ohm inverse (R,V -> I), power (P=VI), loaded divider (R2||R_L), branch current. Verified distinct (different formula, unit, question).

list.defect: The boundary (BIOS/schematic/BoardView NOT auto-imported to general KB) was implicit, not tested.
list.fix: Tests assert importing a document adds 0 KB facts; repair-to-learning adds 0 KB facts; only technician-confirmed cases (learning.py record_case) promote to KB, and only as 'repair-case' category.

list.defect: No test that proprietary repair docs stay scoped to their session.
list.fix: Test asserts a document imported for session A does not surface in session B.

independent_reasoning_test_set.note: The central rule holds: a correct number with wrong/incomplete reasoning is NOT counted as correct, across all 53 independent cases.

memorized_answer_fails_transfer.note: A user who memorized exercise A's number fails the transfer exercise B (different question shape).

what_this_proves: 12 real defects were found in Phase 4 by independent inspection and fixed in 4 stages.
The independent reasoning test set (53 cases, written separately from the dev set) grades 100% correctly per category — including the central 'correct number + wrong reasoning -> not correct' rule.
Hint and Guided never disclose the solution across 30 exercises each; Full discloses with provenance; the default level is guided (not full).
Mastery resists memorization: 5 solves of the SAME exercise leave the distinct count at 1; a memorized answer fails the transfer exercise (different question shape).
All 24 technician scenarios have a reference answer with reasoning and a valid source; synthetic and confirmed-repair scenarios are kept separate.
Exercise generation is physically validated: 0 invalid exercises across 100 seeds; RC answers accepted in both seconds and ms.

Architectural boundaries hold: documents are never auto-imported to the general KB; proprietary repair docs stay session-scoped; only technician-confirmed cases promote to KB (as 'repair-case' category).
Phase 3 behavior (orchestrate, analyze, learn record) is unchanged; the Phase 4 benchmark still passes 10/10.
limitations_honest: The reasoning evaluator is rule-based and heuristic. The 53-case independent set passes 100%, but a sufficiently subtle wrong reasoning phrased with all the right keywords could still slip through. The independent set is a strong signal, not a proof of perfection.

The 24 technician scenarios are validated structurally (reference + source + reasoning); they are not yet wired into the exercise generator's flow as gradable exercises. Wiring them in is a Phase 4.2 task.
The transfer shapes cover 4 skills (ohm_kirchhoff, electrical_math, voltage_divider, series_parallel); the other 12 skills do not yet have transfer shapes.

The physical-validation bounds (V 0.8-60V, I 1mA-10A, P 100µW-50W) are generous board-level heuristics, not component-datasheet limits. A 50 W exercise is rejected, but a 49 W exercise is accepted — the boundary is a sanity check, not a precise derating calculation.
